disease_profile.stage: Diagnosed 5 years ago. CD4 nadir 280 cells/uL. Never had an AIDS-defining illness. Has been on ART since diagnosis with intermittent adherence issues.
disease_profile.treatment_regimen: Triumeq (abacavir/dolutegravir/lamivudine) -- one tablet daily. Has been prescribed this regimen for 3 years. Admits to missing doses 2-3 times per week, sometimes taking 'drug holidays' of several days when she feels well.
key_symptoms: Intermittent low-grade fatigue she attributes to work stress rather than HIV
disease_profile.trajectory: Viral load has fluctuated between undetectable and low-level viremia (50-500 copies/mL) due to inconsistent adherence. Last viral load was 340 copies/mL -- detectable but low. CD4 is 410 cells/uL. Physician has repeatedly counseled about adherence importance. Has not developed resistance so far.

demographics.marital_status: Separated from husband (relationship strained since disclosure), two children (ages 8 and 12)
demographics.education: High school diploma, certified nursing assistant
demographics.mode_of_transmission: Heterosexual contact (believes she acquired it from a previous partner before marriage)

causes: A previous partner who did not disclose his status
